_comment: Error-level db lint findings that are KNOWN and consciously accepted.
The gate fails on anything NOT listed here, so this file is the line between
'we decided to live with that' and 'something new just broke'.
An empty baseline would be ideal. A growing one is a smell: every entry is a
known-broken function shipped on purpose, and each needs a reason and a date
so the next person can tell a deliberate deferral from an abandoned one.
To accept a new finding, add it here WITH a reason. To retire one, fix the
function and delete the entry -- the gate warns when a baseline entry no
longer appears, so stale entries surface instead of silently protecting
code that no longer needs it.

accepted.reason: Diagnostics-only, reached from /tools/repricer-eligibility-diagnostics. inventory has no available_quantity, reserved_quantity or inbound_quantity -- only `units`. Mapping them is a judgement about original intent, not a rename, and a wrong guess in repricer code is worse than a page that throws. Deferred deliberately 2026-08-20.

Same page, same call. repricer_assignments has NO deletion column at all, so there is no successor to map `WHERE deleted_by IS NULL` onto -- the filter either drops entirely or the table lost a concept. Needs a decision, not a rename. Deferred deliberately 2026-08-20.
